purpose: Measure parser-created precision/output-type constraint state omitted from failed build metadata
allowed_native_operations: Create TensorRT Builder/network/parser and parse source graph
Read every layer precision_is_set and every output output_type_is_set; read values only when explicitly set
Apply same88 Clip numeric bound corrections then record the same metadata again
Write separate metadata outputs and supervise process/resources
prohibited_operations: Creating/executing an engine or CUDA inference
Changing source/frozen files or layer precision/output type settings
Treating parsed dtype/constraints as actual engine adoption
interpretation: Constraint presence can limit hypotheses but cannot prove the failure node, show OBEY is sole cause, or establish build/execution success.
